hasAction.description: Decision D5: the meaning of the type (prefLabel, definition, subClassOf) is kept apart from the rest. The six-phase position moves from skos:broader to pp:phase (classification); profile, processDescription and provenanceClass move to a node of their own (pp:deployment); the openEO correspondences are grouped apart. The plan was already a node of its own.

Attached to the Implementation Profile https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/implementation-profile/radiometric-index-single-band (implementsProfile), after checking its signature (docs/ATTACHMENTS.md).

subClassOf changes from https://w3id.org/ogc/rim/activity-type/ActivityType to https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/activity-type/radiometric-index, the activity type of the operation in bblocks-generic-profiles (decision of 2026-11-10), with the same entity type(s): http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature, http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature.

definition: Computes NDVI, NDWI and SAVI from Sentinel-2 red, green and NIR bands.

openeoEquivalence.rationale: Composite, one tool computing three indices from the same three-band input at once. NDVI alone would be closeMatch `ogc.openeo.processes.cubes.ndvi`; NDWI alone closeMatch `ogc.openeo.processes.math.indices.normalized_difference` (as in `water-bodies.norm-diff` and `kindgrove.mangrove`); SAVI (soil-adjusted, not a plain normalized difference) has no openEO process in this register. Kept `none` for the tool as a whole since no single openEO process covers the composite.

decomposition.note: soil-adjusted vegetation index, no openEO process in this register
